sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the Desk page
sections.what: Brings in display pieces, desk data functions, the story title helper, the not-found helper, translation helpers, the depth switch and styles.
sections.why: Needed to load data and draw each part of the page.

sections.name: metadata
sections.title: Page settings and language rule
sections.what: Sets the tab title and tells Next to build only the listed languages.
sections.why: The code comment says there is one prebuilt page per language.
sections.watch_out: A new language must be added to the language list, or its page returns Not Found.

sections.name: generateStaticParams, pts
sections.title: Language list and points helper
sections.what: Lists each supported language so one page is built per language, and turns a fraction into whole points.
sections.why: Likely reason: prebuilt pages load fast, and whole points are easier to read.
sections.watch_out: Rounding to whole points hides small changes.

sections.name: DeskPage (part 1)
sections.title: Building the item list
sections.what: Checks the language, prepares translations and labels, loads items and pending sports, prepares the text for every depth, then draws each item card with its swing, receipts, stories and attribution.
sections.why: The code comment says every depth is verified for every item, so the switch only chooses which to show.
sections.watch_out: Work grows with items times depths, so a large brief slows the build.

sections.name: DeskPage (part 2)
sections.title: Pending sports and page end
sections.what: Draws a box listing sports without usable data and the reason, then closes the page.
sections.why: Likely reason: readers see which sports are missing instead of having them hidden.
sections.watch_out: The box only appears when the pending list is not empty.

summary: Builds the Desk page for each supported language, listing verified sports items with their swing and supporting stories.
purpose: Lets readers see short, sourced sports items in their own language, each with a choice of depth.
why: The code comment says there is one prebuilt page per language and the proxy sends readers to their language.
how: Checks the language is supported, prepares translations, loads the items and pending sports, prepares text for every depth of every item, then draws each item with its sport, replay badge, headline, depth text, swing value and note, supporting stories with receipts, and attribution. Pending sports are listed at the end.
inputs: Language code from the address, the desk brief, translation messages and the phrased text for each item.
outputs: The Desk page with a list of items and a section for pending sports.
risks: Text is built for every depth of every item, so a large brief makes the build slower. Unsupported languages return Not Found. Several type casts hide possible mistakes from the compiler.
debug: If a language returns Not Found, check LANGS and isLang. If an item has no text, check phraseItem. If a raw message key shows, check the translation keys.
